verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench, so a project instructions file for coding standards is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an AGENTS.md-style rules file, project instructions file, or convention configuration that the agent follows. The only config file mentioned is a local Provider config path (ZCODE_BUILTIN_PROVIDER_CONFIG_FILE), which is an unrelated setting and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows
